results.note: Korea JoongAng Daily (1 Nov), citing the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources: October exports $115.3bn, up 93.7% year on year.
October's $115.3bn is below September's $120.9bn (a record for an October only).
Provisional government data of Sunday 1 Nov: gross GST ₹2.31 lakh crore, up 22.9%, also Social News XYZ and Daily Excelsior; no PIB release was read, per the two-outlet route.

Autocar India and Hans India (1 Nov): total sales 2,76,120 (2.76 lakh), a monthly record, above 236,013. Maruti's own release was not reachable, and Autocar's components do not sum to its total; the headline figure agrees across two outlets.

No new Kantar model found: ČT24's summary of 1 Nov, the ČTK list and the planning file of 31 Oct do not mention one and politpro's Kantar table ends with the August poll; the ČT topic page itself could not be opened.
Kyiv Independent, citing BNT and the central election commission, reports Yotova 57.58% to Gyurov 39.47% with 99.95% of protocols processed in the 1 Nov runoff; cik.bg itself could not be fetched.

Kyiv Independent reports runoff turnout of about 27-29%, 'a few percentage points higher' than the first round's record low, so above 22.98% across the whole range; cik.bg itself could not be fetched.
CTK via Ceske noviny on 2 Nov still reports the full-day CT and CRo strike and Tuesday's protest as going ahead, and a CTK headline says the strike began, so it was not called off by 1 Nov.

Al Jazeera on 2 Nov reports no date announced and no acceptance of the US proposal, with Baghaei saying talks could begin 'within a short period' only if Iran's demands are met; Reuters via Al-Monitor describes Doha contacts through Qatari mediators with no US delegation reported.

The Yahoo-hosted report, matched by AP via ABC News and Iowa Public Radio, says Trump spoke in person on 1 Nov at rallies in Dubuque, Iowa, and Salina, Kansas, with Iowa Republican candidates present.

TASS reports the seven countries met on 1 Nov and decided to maintain September 2026 required production for December, keeping quotas at the November level; Iraq Business News quotes the same statement, and opec.org could not be fetched.

Puente announced his resignation in Congress on Tuesday 3 November, after the window closed, as RTVE and La Vanguardia report; El País refused scripted reading and La Moncloa and the BOE were not checked.

On 3 November the Jerusalem Post counted 46 confirmed recommendations for Netanyahu, all from his own bloc, against 48 for Eisenkot, with the Arab parties leaning to Eisenkot, so none of the six outside parties had announced for Netanyahu; single outlet, as Times of Israel refused and Haaretz and Ynet carried no such report in what was read.

RFE/RL's Moldovan service on 3 November describes the truce as in force from 27 October to 1 November, the scheduled end given by Lubinets (24tv.ua), with no extension reported; only this one post-deadline outlet states it, and no official statement was read directly.

cik.bg refuses scripted reading; Wikipedia's results table citing the election commission gives 1,902,933 votes of 6,637,274 registered, 28.67%, and Novinite's final CEC candidate totals sum to its 1,900,183 valid votes (https://www.novinite.com/articles/241448/).

On the evening of 4 Nov Dejan Šoškić was still saying only that he would consider the post if the students proposed it (Danas, also N1), so no candidate had been named by 1 Nov; the Student List's own channels were not checked directly.

After searches and reading supplier coverage, no report that E.ON, innogy or PRE announced a 2027 rise for open-ended household tariffs on 31 Oct-1 Nov; this comparison, updated 4 Nov, names only ČEZ for January. Company sites were only partly checkable (innogy refused the request, PRE press and price-list URLs redirected to its home page, E.ON page showed nothing), so this rests on the absence of any report.

On 4 Nov STAN and SPOLU were still weighing Praha sobě or the Pirates as third partner and Hlaváček said there would be no coalition agreement by Thursday, so no such announcement came on 31 Oct-1 Nov.

psp.cz is unreachable; a search and Czech news front pages show no coalition MP other than Pražák leaving on 31 Oct-1 Nov, and on 31 Oct the ANO and Motorists club chairs said no one else planned to go.
